hooks.command: d=$(jj workspace root 2>/dev/null || pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/hooks/run.res" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/hooks/run.res" ] || exit 0; e="$d/hooks/run.res.mjs"; r="$d/node_modules/.bin/rescript"; if [ ! -f "$e" ] && [ -x "$r" ]; then "$r" build >&2; [ -f "$e" ] || { "$r" clean >&2; "$r" build >&2; }; fi; if [ ! -f "$e" ] && [ -f "$d/.jj/repo" ]; then m=$(cd "$d/.jj" && cd "$(cat repo)/../.." && pwd); [ -f "$m/hooks/run.res.mjs" ] && e="$m/hooks/run.res.mjs"; fi; [ -f "$e" ] || { echo "hooks: $e is not built and building did not make it; run mise run build in $d" >&2; exit 2; }; exec node "$e"
